subject: ict
title: Introduction to Information and Communication Technology
summary: Basic concepts of ICT, computer components, and safe technology use

sections.title: What is ICT?
sections.content: ICT stands for Information and Communication Technology. It includes all technologies used to handle telecommunications, broadcast media, audio-visual processing, and network-based control systems. ICT combines computers, the internet, telephones, television, and radio. In modern Bangladesh, ICT is transforming education, healthcare, agriculture, and business through initiatives like Digital Bangladesh.

sections.title: Computer Basics
sections.content: A computer is an electronic device that processes data and performs tasks according to instructions. The main components are: (1) Input devices (keyboard, mouse, scanner), (2) Output devices (monitor, printer, speaker), (3) Processing unit (CPU), (4) Memory (RAM and storage). Hardware refers to physical parts, while software refers to programs and instructions.

sections.title: Using the Internet Safely
sections.content: The internet is a global network connecting millions of computers. Students should learn safe internet practices: never share personal information online, use strong passwords, do not talk to strangers, tell an adult if something makes you uncomfortable. Useful educational websites include Britannica, Khan Academy, and the NCTB's online resources.

sections.title: ICT in Daily Life
sections.content: ICT is used everywhere in Bangladesh: mobile banking (bKash, Nagad) for money transfers, online classes and educational videos during school closures, digital health services, e-government services, and social media for communication. Learning ICT skills is essential for future careers and for contributing to the Digital Bangladesh vision.
